_about: The route table (roadmap 393.6, owner answer 1: the roadmap names which model does each item). Written by hand and reviewed in a diff; never generated. Its first content is the table in .roundtable/milestone-draft-2026-09-25/4-prompt.md §5. An item names its route with a `Route: <id>` line; milestone.py refuses an item whose route is not a key here and a malformed entry (a tier outside top, balanced, fast or Planner among them). A tier the owner set to `none` runs on `top` (§5, and owner decision O14), and `--tier`/`--model` record the tier and model actually used. Hand-up conditions are copied only where §5 gives one (build). Jev never reads or writes a route.

build.handup_when: the Accept is wrong or the premise is false

design.critic: 2 fresh critics running /design-grill, then flow mode
design.never: writes CSS or inline styles; uses bo-skeleton; ships hallmark or wireframe output (critique only)
design._note: §5 gives this hand-up no condition. An unresolved critic verdict after round 3 is NOT a hand-up: §8 stage 6 files it as a Slice 397 item on route design, and the stage continues.

mechanical.returns: the edit, with before and after counts

collect._note: §5: 'read-only gathering'. It runs inside the item that dispatched it and records no row of its own, so it names no loop and the recorder refuses --route collect.
